FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) (COLLECTION OF TOLLS)

(FEDERAL HIGHWAY ROUTE 2) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2016

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of the

Federal Roads (Private Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister makes

the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Private Management)

(Collection of Tolls) (Federal Highway Route 2) (Amendment) Order 2016.

 (2) This Order is deemed to have come into operation on

12 January 2012.

Amendment of paragraph 2

2. The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls)

(Federal Highway Route 2) Order 1993 [P. U. (A) 372/1993], which is referred to

as the "principal Order" in this Order, is amended in subparagraph 2(1) –

(a) by substituting for the words "Projek Lebuh Raya Utara-Selatan

Berhad" the words "Projek Lebuh Raya Usahasama Berhad";

(b) by substituting for the words "1 January 2002 to 31 May 2030"

the words "12 January 2012 to 31 December 2038";

(c) by substituting for the words "column (2) of the First Schedule and

First Schedule—A, tolls as appropriate as specified in column (2) of

the First Schedule and First Schedule—A according to the concession

year as specified in column (1) of the First Schedule and

First Schedule—A" the words "column (1) of the First Schedule and

First Schedule—A, tolls as appropriate as specified in column (2) of

the First Schedule and First Schedule—A according to the concession

years as specified in column (1) of the First Schedule and

First Schedule—A".

Substitution of First Schedule

3. The principal Order is amended by substituting for the First Schedule the

following Schedule:

"FIRST SCHEDULE

[Subparagraph 2(1)]

RATES OF TOLLS AT BATU TIGA TOLL PLAZA FOR THE PERIOD FROM

12 JANUARY 2012 UNTIL 31 DECEMBER 2016

(1)

Classes of Vehicles

(2)

Toll Payable

(RM)

1. Vehicles with two axles and three or four wheels

(excluding taxis and buses)

1.10

2. Vehicles with two axles and five or six wheels

(excluding buses)

1.50

3. Vehicles with three axles or more

(excluding buses)

2.20

4. Taxis 0.40

5. Buses 0.90

For the purpose of calculating the number of axles and wheels of a vehicle, the axles

and wheels of any trailer towed by the vehicle shall be included as part of the axles

and wheels of the vehicle.".
